```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits input] --> B{Operation}

    B -->|Received document| C[ASSAY]

    subgraph ASSAY["ASSAY — read-only"]
        C --> C1[Check Audience, Scope, Format, Path]
        C1 --> C2[Compress to floor residue]

        C3 --> C4[Find operative sentence]
        C4 --> C5[Report ratio, erosion direction, and flags]
        C5 --> C6["This is a finding, not a draft."]
    end

    subgraph PROVIDE["PROVIDE — negotiation side"]
        D --> D1{Mode known?}

        D1 -->|Yes| D3[Check Audience, Scope, Format, Path]
        D3 --> D4{Floor passes?}
        D4 -->|No| D5[Ask up to three questions]
        D5 --> D3
        D4 -->|Yes| D6[Compress the prompt]
        D6 --> D7{Cut removed specification?}
        D7 -->|Yes| D8[Revert the cut]
        D8 --> D6
        D7 -->|No| D9{Two empty cuts?}
        D9 -->|No| D10{Floor still passes?}
        D10 -->|No| D11[Return last passing version]
        D11 --> D12[Output contract]
        D10 -->|Yes| D6
        D9 -->|Yes| D12
        D12 --> G["Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?"]
        G -->|Keep negotiating| D6
        G -->|Freeze, execute, or run it| H{Tools available?}
        H -->|No| I[Gate stays closed]
        H -->|Yes| J[Contract frozen. Executing.]
        J --> K{Result}
        K -->|Success| L[Done]
        K -->|Floor failure| M[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
        M --> D6
    end
```
